packet.headline_seed: Ford rehires ‘gray beard’ engineers after AI falls short
packet.description_seed: "Mistakenly we thought that by just introducing artificial intelligence ... that would produce a high-quality product.”

what: Ford rehires ‘gray beard’ engineers after AI falls short

clean_source_blocks.text: "Mistakenly we thought that by just introducing artificial intelligence ... that would produce a high-quality product.”

Ford executives said they have hired 350 veteran engineers — some of them were former employees, while others had been working at suppliers — after artificial intelligence and automated systems failed to deliver the desired quality level. Bloomberg reports the company’s chief operating officer Kumar Galhotra told journalists that Ford had been “relying more and more on automated quality systems” with disappointing results. So the company “brought back technical specialists,” and those specialists “hunt for failure points before a part ever reaches the plant floor.”
